text: Which AI automation consultants in Perth specialise in Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents, and practical AI workflow automation for mid-market businesses?

result.keyword: Which AI automation consultants in Perth specialise in Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents, and practical AI workflow automation for mid-market businesses?

items.markdown:
In Perth, the ecosystem of boutique and specialist AI consultancies focusing specifically on the Microsoft ecosystem (Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and agentic workflows) is growing to meet mid-market demand. `Notable Perth-based consultants and firms specialising in these areas include:` 

- **[Frontrow Technology](https://frontrowtech.com.au/ai-consultant-perth)** : Specialises in Applied AI consulting tailored specifically for mid-market businesses in Perth. Their core capabilities include Microsoft 365 Copilot deployments, custom Copilot Studio agents, and Azure AI Foundry workloads. Notably, the practice is led by a multi-award-winning Microsoft MVP, making them a strong fit for organisations seeking deep enterprise-grade Microsoft alignment scaled for mid-market budgets.[[1]](https://frontrowtech.com.au/ai-consultant-perth)
- **Opticloud Solutions** : A Perth-based Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and AI consulting team that focuses heavily on building production-ready Copilot Studio agents grounded in internal data (such as SharePoint and Dataverse). They specialise in designing "agents that act"—connecting Copilot Studio with Power Automate to automate complex business processes like raising tickets, updating records, routing approvals, and integrating directly into Microsoft Teams.[[1]](https://opticloud.com.au/solutions/copilot-studio-ai-agents/)

#### Key Focus Areas for Mid-Market AI Consulting

When evaluating these or similar specialists in Western Australia, mid-market firms typically look for consultants who provide:

1. **Data Grounding & Security:** Ensuring custom agents pull exclusively from controlled internal repositories (SharePoint, Dataverse) rather than the open internet, respecting existing corporate access permissions.[[1]](https://opticloud.com.au/solutions/copilot-studio-ai-agents/)
2. **Action-Oriented Workflows:** Moving beyond simple Q&A chatbots to agents that can read/write data across line-of-business systems via Power Automate and Microsoft Graph.
3. **Adoption & Governance:** Aligning deployment with the Power Platform governance framework so data boundaries and compliance needs remain intact.[[1]](https://opticloud.com.au/solutions/copilot-studio-ai-agents/)
